    Class FeatureTranslateCommand

    Translate a fixed set of arcs and point shapes by (dx, dy) in source-data coordinates. Reverses by negating the offset.

    Lightweight in-place mutation — no dataset replacement, no copy. Cost is O(vertices in the affected arcs + point coords). The same command class handles point-only, path-only, and mixed selections within one source.

    Mergeable: consecutive translates of the SAME (source, arcIds, pointFeatures) tuple within MERGE_WINDOW_MS accumulate their deltas into a single entry — useful for arrow-key nudges or any UI that batches Emap.translateSelected per keystroke.

    Known v1 limitation: arcs shared with unselected features are translated once (correctly per the topology model), which means the unselected neighbour's geometry follows along. The proper fix requires cutting shared arcs at the selection boundary first; tracked as a follow-up.

    Example

    Runnable example association: attribute-editing, china-editing, draw-snap-clear.

    merge

    • merge(next: EditCommand): void

      Companion to mergeable: invoked by EditHistory.push only when next.mergeable(this) returned true. Mutates this command in place to absorb next's effect; next is discarded after the call returns. Implementations typically refresh a "newest-coordinate" field while preserving the oldest "starting" capture so undo still reverses the cumulative work.

    mergeable

    • mergeable(prev: EditCommand): boolean

      Optional merge predicate, evaluated by EditHistory.push against the current top of the undo stack. When true, the new command is NOT pushed; instead prev.merge(this) is invoked and prev absorbs the follow-up's effect. Used to collapse rapid repeated edits — successive arrow-key vertex nudges, mouse-drag tween steps, etc. — into one undoable entry.

      Implementations should be cheap (O(N) at worst over command-internal fields) and stable (no I/O, no side effects).

      Parameters

      • prev: EditCommand

        prev accepts EditCommand for mergeable. Required; omission is not allowed. Must be assignable to EditCommand.
